reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Kyverno v1.13.0 is end-of-life since 2026-08", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: Environments on Kyverno 1.18 or earlier lines, including v1.13.0, receive no further releases, bug fixes or security fixes upstream. They keep running but are unsupported.
consequence.remediation: Plan a migration to a supported minor line (1.19 at present) instead of relying on upstream fixes.

proposed.statement: Kyverno v1.19.0 (2026-08) ended patch support for the 1.18 line and all earlier lines, including v1.13.0, so environments on those lines get no further bug or security fixes and should plan a migration.
